1936, October
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 144 Cont.
Oct. 7 Mrs. Honore Mercier - 39 - Quebec Very serious operation threatened last June was Enrolled ... & prayed for .... O.K. without operation ..... Thanks.
Aunt of above Miss Chalifoux wishes to sell her property here ...
4 Baby Eliz Dimitry - 5 weeks old - Enteritis - became almost dead. Baby was small at birth like 6 1bs. - fell to 4 lbs. Enrolled Sept. 27. Parents also relatives. Some of them away from confession for years, have come back to their faith ... Baby reported To-night - not only living but improving -
6 Rose Di Trapani - 33 - fears about losing mind; has husband & 7 chil- dren. . .. . away from confession 16 yrs., husband too. - promises to go back to sacraments.
Another party here last Sunday away from Confession for 8 yrs. quite similar.
Page 145 Oct. 6 Mrs. Le Duc - 58 - fearing inward goitre - not well for over 16 yrs. Husband was in and enrolled her yesterday quite anxious about her condition. She comes To-day feeling decided better. . . .
Mrs. Mary Schwab - 60 - breast-cancer - enrolled early in August. Severe pains have ceased but otherwise things coming slowly. Husband died two yrs. ago. Her sister - mother of her two step children died 20 yrs. ago Promised Poor Souls offering every month if they help'd . .
R. Duncan - last week - Report ..... "Immediate results" Ex ... Joseph Cyr & Sister ... to get work
Marg. Brennon - 70 - heart trouble ...
Ida M. Doenser - 67 - tuomer - intense headaches. Geraldine Fortier - 22 - company with ....
Margaret Jean Gribbey - 18 mo. not bap ..
Page 146 Oct. 11 11 Baby Mary Jan Sorensen - 20 months with 1072 fever. July 8th last was enrolled by phone % Grandfather at 9 P.M. Next morning it was down to 105. Kept up for five days .... She lives To-day & is well, save leakage of heart. For this she was enrolled To-day - parents promising perpet- tual enrollment ....
